missing_rule.title: Baseline profile parameter missing from export
missing_rule.remediation: Verify effective kernel default in RZ11 or RSPARAM and include parameter in instance profile.

parameters.name: login/no_automatic_user_sapstar
parameters.title: Automatic SAP* fallback user must be disabled
parameters.remediation: Set login/no_automatic_user_sapstar = 1 in DEFAULT.PFL and restart the application server.

parameters.name: rsau/enable
parameters.title: Security Audit Log (SM19/SM20) must be active
parameters.remediation: Set rsau/enable = 1 and configure static audit filters in SM19/RSAU_CONFIG.

parameters.name: auth/rfc_authority_check
parameters.title: RFC authorization check (S_RFC) must be enforced
parameters.remediation: Set auth/rfc_authority_check >= 1 (recommended 6 or 9) to enforce S_RFC checks on all calls.

parameters.name: login/min_password_lng
parameters.title: Minimum password length below baseline
parameters.remediation: Set login/min_password_lng >= 8 (or 12+ per corporate identity policy) in DEFAULT.PFL.

parameters.name: login/fails_to_user_lock
parameters.title: Failed logon lockout threshold too permissive
parameters.remediation: Set login/fails_to_user_lock <= 5 to mitigate brute-force password guessing.

parameters.name: login/fails_to_session_end
parameters.title: Failed logon attempts per session too permissive
parameters.remediation: Set login/fails_to_session_end <= 3 to terminate SAP GUI sessions after repeated bad passwords.

parameters.name: login/password_expiration_time
parameters.title: Password expiration interval outside baseline (1-90 days)
parameters.remediation: Set login/password_expiration_time between 1 and 90 days for dialog password rotation.

parameters.name: login/disable_multi_gui_login
parameters.title: Multiple concurrent SAP GUI logons allowed
parameters.remediation: Set login/disable_multi_gui_login = 1 to prevent shared credential usage across terminals.
